name: G-Fest
blurb: The world's largest kaiju convention, celebrating Godzilla and giant movie monsters, run by Daikaiju Enterprises at the Hyatt Regency O'Hare.
notes: The seed URL g-fan.com is the G-FAN magazine/publisher homepage, not the convention's own site; the actual official convention site is g-festcon.com (g-fan.com's own news post for the 2026 show says 'Go to the dedicated G-FESTcon.com website'), so url was corrected here. G-FEST 2026 ran July 10-12, 2026 at the Hyatt Regency O'Hare, Rosemont, IL - before this window starts (2026-10-05). g-festcon.com is a JS-heavy Wix site that did not surface any 2027 date text on the homepage as of this check, and no 2027 announcement was found elsewhere, so editions is empty.
